content.text: {"name":"V04_V02_flow_spread_tsz_low_T","hypothesis":"Groups whose V04 rate is unusually high versus their own history, relative to V02 (cross-sectionally standardized spread of time-series z-scores), earn lower next-month relative returns, especially when T is in its low regime, since stretched flows mean-revert.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or HAC t-statistic is above -1, particularly in the low T regime.","expression":"regime(spread(tsz(V04,60),tsz(V02,60)),\"low\")"}
